description: Get Figma layout, styling, text, components, and exported SVG assets. Render textRuns instead of duplicating text; expand base typography tokens before applying run overrides. Preserve layout.position/left/top, per-edge borderWidths, and gradientHandlePositions. SVG files are in svgAssetsFolder. Keep each node's layout footprint and place its asset at svgViewport x/y (an omitted x or y means 0) using svgViewport width/height; do not stretch the expanded asset to the node's original size. Compare against the PNG render of the requested node at renderedDesignNodeAssetsFolder + renderedDesignNodePathInAssetFolder when present. A large COMPONENT_SET root keeps its container here, and its variants are in root.file (index.json plus one JSON file per variant).

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to fetch, often found in a provided URL like figma.com/(file|design)/<fileKey>/...

includeComponentVariants.description: Set true only when building components from a component library: also returns every other variant of each component this design uses (all sizes, colors, and states), with their props and any visuals that can be fetched. Every component set is written as a JSON file in componentSetsFolder and listed in componentSets by name, with its propKeys and propValues; a large set becomes a folder there with index.json and one JSON file per variant, named by node id. Every `file` value is relative to componentSetsFolder. Leave false when rebuilding this design; the response is smaller and faster.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to fetch, often found as URL parameter node-id=<nodeId>, always use if provided. Use format '1234:5678' or 'I5666:180910;1:10515;1:10336' for multiple nodes.

resolveVariables.description: Whether to resolve variable references to their actual values. Set to false if already fetched once.

svgOutputDir.description: Directory to save SVG assets to. Defaults to system temp directory.

name: get_figma_design
title: Get Figma Design
